daily.today_energy: Mercury's vibes are giving you permission to pause and reassess. You've been carrying so much lately—today's about releasing what no longer serves and making space for something fresher.
daily.love: Whether you're partnered or solo, there's an invitation to be more vulnerable. That person you've been thinking about? The universe is nudging you toward honest conversation. Show up as yourself.
daily.career: Your practical energy is unmatched right now. That project or idea you've been sitting on deserves attention. Trust your instincts—you already know what needs to happen next.
daily.health: Your body's asking for intentional rest, not just sleep. Movement that feels good to your soul (even a slow walk) will ground your energy and calm that restless mind.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is calling you to trust your instincts, Cap. Mercury's influence has you feeling more introspective than usual—lean into it. You're processing something important, and clarity is coming faster than you think.
weekly.love: Venus is whispering softly in your corner, inviting you to be vulnerable with someone who matters. Whether you're coupled up or single, authenticity is your superpower rn. Show up as your real self, not the polished version.
weekly.career: Your energy is quieter this week, but that's actually strategic. Use this time to organize your thoughts and plant seeds for future projects. Small actions taken now will compound into something meaningful by month's end.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness. This isn't the week to push hard—instead, prioritize rest, hydration, and movement that feels nourishing rather than punishing. Listen to what your system actually needs right now.
